confirmed_findings.before: A saved allowed Dinner outfit restored after an excluded Work request remained linked to lastRequest=Work. An unrelated Work rejection or Cancel evaluated the current card against Work and hid it.
confirmed_findings.repair: Current-frame checks use currentContext(); retained option lists continue using their producing request context.

confirmed_findings.before: Cancelling the first Work avatar could retain a Work option list beside a restored manual Dinner outfit. Physical IDs alone could rebind the current card to a Work option and label it generated.
confirmed_findings.repair: Reconciliation retains rank metadata only for the actual owned row object, engine origin, matching occasion/formality and physical selection. The real retained-engine control still keeps its rank.

confirmed_findings.before: An aborted stale 401 could clear a newer session; obsolete logout cleanup could disconnect a new login; Disconnect/Cancel in the promise gap before login publication could allow stale credentials to be published.
confirmed_findings.repair: Current-request guards precede 401 effects and follow response-body reads. Session epochs bind authentication publication. Logout copies Authorization synchronously and immediately removes local credentials before awaiting transport.
confirmed_findings.repair_regression_caught: The first epoch repair skipped logout cleanup when settings Close cancelled the request, leaving the session signed in. The final immediate-local-clear implementation repairs that regression.

confirmed_findings.repair: Static and saved vetoes filter reference rows and provider proposals before history priority, physical-item capacity, rendering and evaluation. Final integration checks remain.
confirmed_findings.concrete_postcheck: Reject S10/DS022/T022 clothing in Work: the list remains15 with permitted S11/DS022/T022 replacing it; no global tie ban is inferred.

confirmed_findings.before: During independent cross-review of the first hybrid repair, a real IndexedDB peer committed a rejection while propose awaited and BroadcastChannel delivery was disabled. Cached synchronous checks still allowed20 renders and20 evaluation images, including the rejected outfit. The final durable guard did reject publication.
confirmed_findings.repair: Visual checks the captured token durably before proposing and after each awaited proposal/render/evaluation boundary, including immediately before evaluation. It rechecks dependency identity and cancellation.
confirmed_findings.concrete_postcheck: The identical peer-commit reproduction now stops with0 renders,0 evaluation images and no result. Separate tests cover peer commits during render/evaluate and healthy durable continuation.

confirmed_no_new_defect: Eight user scopes retain independent named-garment meanings. Historical Neither remains exact including watch; historical all remains all occasions.
Canonical/wire selection normalization and occasion aliases do not rewrite original stored/exported event payloads.
Overlapping rejects, duplicate imports and all/current occasion records remain independently undoable. Temporary skips do not become permanent backup records.
Unknown scopes, invalid namespace/Undo targets, corrupted records, unreadable storage and aborted writes fail closed in the listed current tests without replacing prior data with an empty ledger.
Explicit approved outfits and learning rank cannot bypass saved bans or static owner rules.
Native suggestion exposure is written for accepted Research/heuristic lists; private review, Curated/Visual and simple navigation do not masquerade as native20 exposure or actual wear.

Targeted source sink search found no innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, eval or new Function in the reviewed application/rejection/provider paths. The only matching postMessage is a revision-only BroadcastChannel notification; this is a bounded source review, not a general security proof.
previous_claims_requiring_qualification: A final rejection veto was insufficient to establish that rejected candidates never consumed Curated capacity or reached Visual assessment. This round found and repaired those earlier-stage gaps.
The initial authentication epoch repair was not accepted as complete: the Sign out then Close control exposed a regression, which was fixed and included in the final8-case pass.
These results cover the exact reviewed boundaries and tests. They do not mean every historical code path was executed or every possible concurrent schedule was exhausted.
boundaries_and_limits: Visual service transport, provider responses and images are controlled fixtures. The live service is unconfigured; no paid request or model-quality claim is made.
The delayed-notification tests use two actual store facades with fake-indexeddb. Root owns native multi-tab browser timing/lock verification.

If a rejection is committed while an image is already rendering or an evaluation is already in progress, the next durable boundary blocks continuation/publication; completed work cannot be retroactively undone.
Stored-data tampering is detected through validation/reload and durable guards. No claim is made that arbitrary out-of-band index corruption is re-read on every synchronous match.
The preserved synchronous compatibility mutation APIs can bypass newer exclusive wrappers if called directly by historical integrations; active application callers are separately audited and wrapped.
This storage/cross-method round does not re-audit shirt pixels or collar appearance. Root owns asset provenance, visual coverage and protected-artifact integrity.
Frozen Standard/Stage10 runtime artifacts and historical modules were not broadly executed in this round. Active versus targeted review depth is stated per file.
